# improve lookup

Make `lookup` show the body of a shell function instead of echoing its name. The original comparison:

```bash
$ lookup pull
pull
$ which pull
pull () {
        git pull --all --prune --tags --force --rebase
        git submodule update --init --recursive
}
```

`command -v pull` returns just `pull` for a function, and `lookup` printed that and stopped, so for the author's own functions — most of the dotfiles — the helper was useless where it was needed most. The expected behaviour is what `which` does in zsh: print the definition.
